svg.style: max-width: 1019.84px; background-color: rgb(246, 247, 242); font-family: "Segoe UI", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
svg.title: AIB module dependencies
svg.desc: The launcher invokes the CLI, and the web editor calls the server over HTTP. The service uses storage and conversion, which both depend on core. Core maps workbooks through univer-adapter. Schema defines the underlying data contract.
